floorPlans.label: Emaar: Grove Ridge floor plans · Towers 1/2 and townhouses
floorPlans.introduction: Explore the published apartments in Towers 1 and 2 and the townhouse layouts. Where a sheet covers more than one unit group, the area shown spans its printed total areas. Match the unit reference and level on the plan.
floorPlans.note: Plans and dimensions are approximate and subject to developer revisions. Drawings are not to scale; shown furnishings and generic view legends do not guarantee a particular unit’s outlook or sale inclusions.
